description: This file contains UI screenshot test cases for custom button components (NiaButton, NiaOutlinedButton) in an Android Jetpack Compose project. It uses Robolectric for testing, captures UI themes, and verifies button rendering across themes.

classes.name: ButtonScreenshotTests
classes.description: A test class for capturing screenshots of custom button components under different themes in a Compose UI setup.

methods.name: niaButton_multipleThemes
methods.description: Test method that captures the NiaButton component across multiple themes for visual regression.

methods.name: niaOutlineButton_multipleThemes
methods.description: Test method that captures the NiaOutlinedButton component across multiple themes.

methods.name: niaButton_leadingIcon_multipleThemes
methods.description: Test method that captures a NiaButton with a leading icon across multiple themes, with special override parameters.
